for_you.ask: A fresh session per wake for dev, dashboard and me (replaces A3 and A5)?
for_you.detail: Each call carries 211,933 to 329,982 tokens of old context. dev's quiet 15:38 wake: 204,461 of 206,199 fresh was re-loading; dashboard 216,426 of 219,031; me 132,612 of 137,217. Old: the task fires into one standing session. New: a new session each firing (create_new_session_on_fire), same prompt, new key per CLAUDE.md. Saving about 900,000 a day if a fresh wake starts near 40,000 (estimate).
Still open. Angelo's ledgers are on the team page too.

sections.title: 2. Biggest three savings
items: Long sessions (A6): 211,933 to 329,982 cache reads per call for dev, 233,613 for dashboard; most fresh tokens are cache writes re-loading after hours idle.
Quiet wakes: dev's 15:38 wake changed nothing and cost 206,199 fresh.
Sub-agents: dev's 3 review helpers used 207,911 fresh; shorter briefs next.
